chunks: The narrations and reports from the Imams, peace be upon them, state that it is not permissible for a man to undertake voluntary fasting while he still owes something of the obligatory fast. Among those who narrated that are al-Ḥalabī and Abū al-Ṣabāḥ al-Kinānī from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام.

key_terms.الْأَئِمَّةِ: the Imams عليهم السلام as the source of guidance
key_terms.الْفَرْضِ: the obligatory duty that is binding
key_terms.بِالصِّيَامِ: by fasting as an act of worship
key_terms.يَتَطَوَّعَ: to perform a voluntary devotional act

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to observe voluntary fasting while obligatory fasts are still pending?
ai.summary: This report conveys a legal ruling from the Imams عليهم السلام that voluntary fasting is not permitted when a person still has obligatory fasting to make up. It emphasizes prioritizing what is due by obligation before engaging in supererogatory acts of worship.
